note.zh: 本站只收录 A0h 的字节 0-127。字节 128-255 为保留区（原分配给 SFF-8079），不在 v1 范围内。
note.en: This site covers A0h bytes 0-127 only. Bytes 128-255 are reserved (originally allocated to SFF-8079) and out of scope for v1.

name.zh: 厂商特定 ID 字段

description.zh: 收发器类型代码。取值见 SFF-8472 表 5-1。
description.en: Transceiver type code; see SFF-8472 Table 5-1.

description.zh: 标识符的补充代码。取值见 SFF-8472 表 5-2。
description.en: Supplementary code to the identifier; see SFF-8472 Table 5-2.

description.zh: 连接器类型代码。代码表在 SFF-8024，本站不复制该表。
description.en: Connector type code. The code table lives in SFF-8024 and is not reproduced here.

description.zh: 10 个字节的置位表示所符合的电气或光学标准。逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 5-3。
description.en: Set bits across ten bytes declare the electrical or optical standards complied with. Bit meanings are in SFF-8472 Table 5-3.

description.zh: 高速串行编码算法代码。代码表在 SFF-8024。
description.en: High-speed serial encoding algorithm code. The code table lives in SFF-8024.

description.zh: 标称信号速率，单位 100 MBd。取值 FFh 时改由字节 66 与 67 以 250 MBd 为单位描述。
description.en: Nominal signaling rate in units of 100 MBd. A value of FFh moves the definition to bytes 66 and 67 in units of 250 MBd.

description.zh: 速率选择功能类型。取值见 SFF-8472 表 5-6。
description.en: Rate select functionality type; see SFF-8472 Table 5-6.

name.zh: 单模链路长度（km）或铜缆衰减

description.zh: 单模光纤支持的链路长度，单位 km；铜缆实现时为 12.9 GHz 下的衰减，单位 dB。
description.en: Link length supported over single-mode fiber in km, or, for copper implementations, attenuation at 12.9 GHz in dB.

name.zh: 单模链路长度（100 m）或铜缆衰减

description.zh: 单模光纤支持的链路长度，单位 100 m；铜缆实现时为 25.78 GHz 下的衰减，单位 dB。
description.en: Link length supported over single-mode fiber in units of 100 m, or, for copper implementations, attenuation at 25.78 GHz in dB.

description.zh: 50 µm OM2 光纤支持的链路长度，单位 10 m。
description.en: Link length supported over 50 µm OM2 fiber in units of 10 m.

description.zh: 62.5 µm OM1 光纤支持的链路长度，单位 10 m。
description.en: Link length supported over 62.5 µm OM1 fiber in units of 10 m.

name.zh: 多模链路长度（OM4）或铜缆长度

description.zh: 50 µm OM4 光纤支持的链路长度，单位 10 m；铜缆或直连电缆实现时为长度，单位 m。
description.en: Link length supported over 50 µm OM4 fiber in units of 10 m, or, for copper or direct-attach cable, length in m.

name.zh: 多模链路长度（OM3）或附加电缆长度

description.zh: 50 µm OM3 光纤支持的链路长度，单位 10 m；铜缆实现时为长度倍率，基值见 SFF-8472 表 6-1。
description.en: Link length supported over 50 µm OM3 fiber in units of 10 m, or, for copper, a length multiplier whose base values are in SFF-8472 Table 6-1.

description.zh: 厂商名称，ASCII 字符，左对齐，右侧以空格（20h）填充。
description.en: Vendor name in ASCII, left-aligned and padded on the right with spaces (20h).

name.zh: 收发器合规代码（扩展字节）

description.zh: 补充的合规代码字节，逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 5-3。
description.en: Additional compliance code byte; bit meanings are in SFF-8472 Table 5-3.

description.zh: 厂商的 IEEE 公司 ID，3 个字节。
description.en: The vendor's IEEE company ID, three bytes.

description.zh: 厂商料号，ASCII 字符，左对齐，右侧以空格（20h）填充。
description.en: Vendor part number in ASCII, left-aligned and padded on the right with spaces (20h).

description.zh: 厂商为该料号给出的版本级别，ASCII 字符。
description.en: Revision level the vendor assigns to that part number, in ASCII.

description.zh: 默认表示激光波长，单位 nm。当字节 8 的比特位 2（无源电缆）或比特位 3（有源电缆）置位时，字节 60 改为电缆合规标志位，字节 61 全保留；逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 8-1、表 8-2。
description.en: Laser wavelength in nm by default. When bit 2 (passive cable) or bit 3 (active cable) of byte 8 is set, byte 60 becomes cable compliance flags and byte 61 is entirely reserved; bit meanings are in SFF-8472 Tables 8-1 and 8-2.

description.zh: 收发器的光纤通道速率能力代码。
description.en: Code describing the transceiver's Fibre Channel speed capability.

description.zh: 基本 ID 字段的校验和：字节 0 至 62 之和的低 8 位。
description.en: Checksum over the base ID fields: the low 8 bits of the sum of bytes 0 through 62.

description.zh: 8 个单比特指示符，声明实现了哪些可选功能。逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 8-3。
description.en: Eight single-bit indicators declaring which optional features are implemented; see SFF-8472 Table 8-3.

description.zh: 保留，置 0。
description.en: Reserved; set to 0.

description.zh: 置 0 表示按比特位 1 与比特位 5 指示标准功率等级 1、2、3；置 1 表示要求功率等级 4。最大功率在 A2h 字节 66 中声明。
description.en: Set to 0 when bits 1 and 5 select the standard power levels 1, 2 and 3; set to 1 when power level 4 is required. Maximum power is declared in A2h byte 66.

description.zh: 置 0 表示按比特位 1 指示标准功率等级 1 与 2；置 1 表示要求功率等级 3 或功率等级 4。
description.en: Set to 0 when bit 1 selects the standard power levels 1 and 2; set to 1 when power level 3 or power level 4 is required.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了分页，A2h 字节 127 用作页选择。
description.en: Set to 1 when paging is implemented; A2h byte 127 is then used for page select.

description.zh: 置 1 表示模块内带 retimer 或时钟数据恢复电路。
description.en: Set to 1 when the module contains a retimer or clock and data recovery circuit.

description.zh: 置 1 表示制冷型激光发射机实现；置 0 表示非制冷或未规定。
description.en: Set to 1 for a cooled laser transmitter implementation, 0 for uncooled or unspecified.

description.zh: 置 1 表示要求功率等级 2；置 0 表示功率等级 1 或未规定。
description.en: Set to 1 when power level 2 is required, 0 for power level 1 or unspecified.

description.zh: 置 1 表示线性接收输出；置 0 表示限幅、PAM4 或未规定的输出。
description.en: Set to 1 for linear receiver output, 0 for limiting, PAM4 or unspecified output.

description.zh: 8 个单比特指示符，声明实现了哪些可选功能。逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 8-3。
description.en: Eight single-bit indicators declaring which optional features are implemented; see SFF-8472 Table 8-3.

name.zh: 接收机判决阈值已实现

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了接收机判决阈值调节。
description.en: Set to 1 when receiver decision threshold adjustment is implemented.

description.zh: 置 1 表示波长或频率可按 SFF-8690 调谐。
description.en: Set to 1 when wavelength or frequency is tunable per SFF-8690.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了 RATE_SELECT 功能；功能类型见字节 13。
description.en: Set to 1 when the RATE_SELECT function is implemented; the function type is in byte 13.

description.zh: 置 1 表示可禁用高速串行输出。
description.en: Set to 1 when the high-speed serial output can be disabled.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了 TX_FAULT 信号（见 SFF-8419）。
description.en: Set to 1 when the TX_FAULT signal is implemented (see SFF-8419).

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了信号丢失指示，极性与 SFP MSA 相反（常称 Signal Detect）。该行为会导致互操作异常，应避免。
description.en: Set to 1 for a loss-of-signal indication with polarity inverted from the SFP MSA (often called Signal Detect). This behaviour causes interoperability problems and should be avoided.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了按 SFF-8419 定义的信号丢失指示。
description.en: Set to 1 for a loss-of-signal indication defined per SFF-8419.

description.zh: 保留，置 0。
description.en: Reserved; set to 0.

description.zh: 字节 12 不为 FFh 时，表示仍满足规格的速率上限，单位为高于标称速率的百分之一；字节 12 为 FFh 时，以 250 MBd 为单位给出标称速率。取值 00h 表示该字段未使用。
description.en: When byte 12 is not FFh, the upper rate bound still meeting specification, in units of one percent above nominal; when byte 12 is FFh, the nominal rate in units of 250 MBd. A value of 00h means the field is unused.

description.zh: 字节 12 不为 FFh 时，表示仍满足规格的速率下限，单位为低于标称速率的百分之一；字节 12 为 FFh 时，表示标称速率 ±1% 的范围限制。取值为 0 表示该字段未使用。
description.en: When byte 12 is not FFh, the lower rate bound still meeting specification, in units of one percent below nominal; when byte 12 is FFh, a rate window of ±1 percent around nominal. A value of 0 means the field is unused.

description.zh: 厂商分配的序列号，ASCII 字符，左对齐，右侧以空格（20h）填充；16 字节全零表示未规定序列号。
description.en: Vendor-assigned serial number in ASCII, left-aligned and padded on the right with spaces (20h); all sixteen bytes zero means no serial number is specified.

description.zh: 8 个 ASCII 字符：字节 84-85 年份的低两位（00 表示 2000 年），86-87 月份，88-89 月内日期，90-91 厂商批次。日期代码为必填。
description.en: Eight ASCII characters: bytes 84-85 the last two digits of the year (00 meaning 2000), 86-87 the month, 88-89 the day of month, 90-91 a vendor lot code. The date code is mandatory.

description.zh: 8 个单比特指示符，说明诊断监测的实现方式。逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 8-5。
description.en: Eight single-bit indicators describing how diagnostic monitoring is implemented; see SFF-8472 Table 8-5.

description.zh: 为遗留诊断实现保留；符合本规范时必须为 0。
description.en: Reserved for legacy diagnostic implementations; must be 0 to comply with this specification.

description.zh: 置 1 表示按本规范实现了数字诊断监测；此时必须同时实现五项监测并写入告警与警告阈值。
description.en: Set to 1 when digital diagnostic monitoring is implemented per this specification; the five monitored quantities and the alarm and warning thresholds are then mandatory.

description.zh: 置 1 表示直接以物理单位报告已校准的值。
description.en: Set to 1 when calibrated values are reported directly in physical units.

description.zh: 置 1 表示报告的是 A/D 计数值，须用 A2h 字节 56-95 的校准常数换算。
description.en: Set to 1 when raw A/D counts are reported and must be converted with the calibration constants in A2h bytes 56-95.

description.zh: 置 1 表示监测平均功率，置 0 表示监测 OMA。
description.en: Set to 1 to monitor average power, 0 to monitor OMA.

description.zh: 置 1 表示访问 A2h 前必须先执行地址切换序列。
description.en: Set to 1 when the address change sequence must be performed before accessing A2h.

description.zh: 保留，置 0。
description.en: Reserved; set to 0.

description.zh: 保留，置 0。
description.en: Reserved; set to 0.

description.zh: 8 个单比特指示符，声明实现了哪些可选诊断增强特性。逐位含义见 SFF-8472 表 8-6。
description.en: Eight single-bit indicators declaring which optional enhanced diagnostic features are implemented; see SFF-8472 Table 8-6.

description.zh: 置 1 表示全部监测量都实现了可选告警与警告标志。
description.en: Set to 1 when optional alarm and warning flags exist for every monitored quantity.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了可通过寄存器控制的 TX_DISABLE 与状态监测。
description.en: Set to 1 when TX_DISABLE control and monitoring are available through registers.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了 TX_FAULT 的寄存器状态监测。
description.en: Set to 1 when TX_FAULT status is monitored through a register.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了 RX_LOS 的寄存器状态监测。
description.en: Set to 1 when RX_LOS status is monitored through a register.

description.zh: 置 1 表示实现了可通过寄存器控制的 RATE_SELECT 与状态监测。
description.en: Set to 1 when RATE_SELECT control and monitoring are available through registers.

description.zh: 置 1 表示按 SFF-8079 实现了应用选择控制。
description.en: Set to 1 when application select control is implemented per SFF-8079.

description.zh: 置 1 表示按 SFF-8431 实现了软速率选择控制。
description.en: Set to 1 when soft rate select control is implemented per SFF-8431.

description.zh: 保留，置 0。
description.en: Reserved; set to 0.

description.zh: 无符号整数，表示所实现的特性集版本；09h 表示符合 12.4 版，0Ah 及以上保留。取值见 SFF-8472 表 8-8。
description.en: An unsigned integer naming the feature set implemented; 09h means revision 12.4, and 0Ah and above are reserved. See SFF-8472 Table 8-8.

description.zh: 扩展 ID 字段的校验和：字节 64 至 94 之和的低 8 位。
description.en: Checksum over the extended ID fields: the low 8 bits of the sum of bytes 64 through 94.

description.zh: 厂商自由使用的 32 字节 EEPROM 区。
description.en: Thirty-two bytes of vendor-specific EEPROM.

handEditNote: 字段定义按 SFF-8472 Rev 12.4 正文手工整理（地址、位号、取值），说明文字为本项目自写，不复制译文。data/ 下的同名文件由 tools/build_data.py 从本目录重新生成。
